$note: Design transmittals of the Ludwigsburg school from the design team to the client (the city's school construction office and the school). Recipients are roles, not persons; every name is invented.

subject.en: Architecture, design development: floor plans, sections and facade, for approval
subject.de: Architektur Entwurfsplanung: Grundrisse, Schnitte und Fassade zur Freigabe

transmittals.cover_note: Design development set of the classroom wings, sports hall and Mensa, including the timber facade and the separate pupils' path. Please approve for the Technical Committee.

recipients.name: Client representative, school construction office
recipients.response: Approved with two comments: widen the bicycle parking and move the kitchen delivery away from the yard.

recipients.name: Head teacher, primary school
recipients.response: Learning clusters and break yard confirmed by the teaching staff.

items.description: Floor plans ground floor to second floor, 1:100

items.notes: Wood facade on the concrete frame

items.description: Site plan with pupils' path and construction access, 1:500

subject.en: Structural design: frame, foundation and sports hall roof, for review
subject.de: Tragwerksplanung: Skelett, Gruendung und Sporthallendach zur Pruefung

transmittals.cover_note: Structural concept and calculation basis for the concrete frame and the long-span sports hall roof. The Pruefingenieur receives the same set.

recipients.name: Client representative, school construction office
recipients.response: Taken note of; the calculation check by the Pruefingenieur is commissioned.

items.description: Structural concept report with load assumptions
Foundation and frame drawings, ground floor to roof, 1:50
Calculation of the sports hall roof girders

subject.en: Building services: ventilation, heating and heat pump, for approval
subject.de: Technische Gebaeudeausruestung: Lueftung, Heizung und Waermepumpe zur Freigabe

transmittals.cover_note: Concept and layout of the CO2-controlled ventilation of the classrooms, the heat pump and the PV system, with the energy proof basis under the GEG.

recipients.name: Facility management of the city
recipients.response: Maintenance access to the roof plant and the heat pump room confirmed.

items.description: Ventilation concept and schematics for classrooms, sports hall and kitchen

subject.en: Acoustics and fire protection: room acoustics report and fire protection concept, for information
subject.de: Akustik und Brandschutz: Raumakustikgutachten und Brandschutzkonzept zur Information

Fire protection concept with escape route plans
